title: App-driver contract, format 2 (quality spec #qc-contract, docs/adr/0025): qc.toml at a target's root
description: Keys follow annotateanything's qa.toml where they fit. Commands run under sh with QC_REPO set to the repo root; no key names a path on this box (#evidence-portable).

format.description: This contract's format version: picks schemas/qc.v<format>.schema.json

setup.description: Installs or builds the app once, run from the repo root

tags.description: The command that writes every tagged test case at the head with the criterion ids it carries, one JSON object {case: [<spec>#<anchor>, ...]}, to the file OCTO_FEATHER_QC_TAGS names, running no test: the gate's own collector (quality spec #qc-capture), run under sh from the repo root. Absent: a repo whose justfile has a check-tests recipe collects through pytest (just check-tests --collect-only; the kit's tests/gate/conftest.py), and a repo with neither has no tagged test

command.description: The app command a user runs; a drive appends its arguments and runs it from the drive's own working directory

services.description: Services the app needs, by name; empty for an app with none

command.description: Starts the service, run from the repo root

ready.description: How the service is known to be ready: the path its URL answers on

fixture.description: Fixtures, by name; empty for an app that keeps no data

reset.description: Resets the fixture, run from the repo root before a drive

path.description: Where the fixture's data lives, relative to the repo root

values.description: Named values criteria refer to and drives use

demo.description: Per-criterion metadata, keyed by its criterion id <spec>#<anchor> (the spec's file stem and the criterion's anchor): the code paths it covers, whether its demo needs a headless browser, and a demo command only for a criterion no tagged test covers; which tests enforce a criterion is the tag on each test, never a list here (quality spec #qc-contract). `just qc` runs a claimed criterion's demo command at the exact head in the qc sandbox, stores its command, exit status and output in the evidence store, and its exit status is the demo's own checks: 0 passes, any other fails, but for the statuses the command key names, which give insufficient evidence (quality spec #qc-run). An entry without a command is metadata only. Absent or empty: no criterion has any

command.description: Drives the criterion and runs its checks, run under sh from the repo root with QC_REPO set; it does its own setup and fixture resets; its exit status reports its checks, except that it did not run to its end: 77 when a step it needs could not run here (Automake's skip status; say which on stderr, its last line is shown), 126 or 127 when the shell could not run or find a command, above 128 when a signal killed it

browser.description: True when the demo drives a headless browser (the [browser] key's pin); default false

covers.description: The code paths the criterion's tagged tests or demo cover, relative to the repo root

browser.description: Present only when the verify skill drives a headless browser: Playwright's headless Chromium shell, installed once per box where `just install-check` names, which a drive reaches by PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH (remote spec #host-tools)

playwright.description: The Playwright release the verify skill pins, whose headless Chromium shell it drives
